title: AI Explainability Analysis
description: Describe a supported explainability analysis or configure it directly, then review the generated results.

inputs.name: model_upload
inputs.label: Model file
inputs.help: Uploads on selection and updates model_path. Model type must be specified; a filename alone cannot identify it.

inputs.name: dataset_upload
inputs.label: Dataset file
inputs.help: Uploads on selection and updates dataset_path. CSV/TSV column names are suggested as features; review target and ID columns.

inputs.name: background_data_upload
inputs.label: Background data
inputs.help: Required for LSTM: a tensor of (samples, time steps, features). Optional for feedforward models: a table of baseline samples; otherwise the explainer selects them from the dataset.

inputs.name: test_data_upload
inputs.label: LSTM test data
inputs.help: Uploads on selection. LSTM tensor shape: (samples, look_back, features). Positional feature labels can be detected.

inputs.name: config_json
inputs.label: Analysis configuration
inputs.help: Paths and feature suggestions update on file selection. Review model_type and features; your explicit feature names are preserved. Assets-relative paths also work.
